ICS 75.140PCD 06New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis Standard covers the method for the determination of water content of asphalt bitumen and fluxed native asphalt, crude coal tar, road tar, cutback bitumen, Digboi type cutback bitumen and creosote and anthracene oil.2. REFERENCESThe following standards contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this draft standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:334 : 2002 Glossary of terms relating to bitumen and tar (third revision)460 (Part 1) : 2020 Test sieves - Specification: Part 1 Wire cloth test sieves (fourth revision)
